paite: Huan Aaron tapa nihte'n TOUPA ava naih ua asihloh nung un TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
heading: Tatna Ni
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they came near before Yahweh, and died;

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Na unau Aaron houpih inla, puanzak sung Mun Siangthou ah, bawm tung a zahngaihna tutphah ma ah chik lai peuh in leng hong lut het kei heh, asi kha ding hi. Zahngaihna tutphah tung a, meipi a hong kilang ding ka hih ziak in.
english: and Yahweh said to Moses, “Tell Aaron your brother not to come at just any time into the Most Holy Place within the veil, before the mercy seat which is on the ark; lest he die; for I will appear in the cloud on the mercy seat.

paite: Hichibang in Mun Siangthou ah khelh thoihna ding in bawngtuai, halmang thillat ding in belampa toh Aaron ahoh ding ahi.
english: “Aaron shall come into the sanctuary with a young bull for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.

paite: "Puanmalngat puanak siangthou asilh dia, asa khuhna ding in puanmalngat pheituam abun ding, puanmalngat dial akhim ding ahi. Hiaite puansilh siangthou ahi a; akisil masa dia, huchi in asilh phet ding ahi.
english: He shall put on the holy linen tunic. He shall have the linen trousers on his body, and shall put on the linen sash, and he shall be clothed with the linen turban. They are the holy garments. He shall bathe his body in water, and put them on.

paite: "Israel suan mipi omkhawmte a pan khelh thoihna ding in kelpa nih leh halmang thillat ding in belampa khat atawi ding ahi.
english: He shall take from the congregation of the children of Israel two male goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.

paite: Aaron in amah a tuam, khelh thoihna bawngtal pen alan dia, amah leh a-inkote a ding in kilemna abawl ding ahi.
english: “Aaron shall offer the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself and for his house.

paite: Kel nih akai dia, kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul ah TOUPA ma ah akoih ding hi.
english: He shall take the two goats, and set them before Yahweh at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Aaron in kel nih tungthu ah ai asan dia, khat TOUPA a tuam ahi dia, akhat pen thuak sik thuak kel ahi ding.
english: Aaron shall cast lots for the two goats: one lot for Yahweh, and the other lot for the scapegoat.

paite: Aaron in TOUPA a tuam dia puk kel pen ala dia, khelh thoihna ding in alan ding hi.
english: Aaron shall present the goat on which the lot fell for Yahweh, and offer him for a sin offering.

paite: Thuak sik thuak kel dia puk pen kilemna bawlna dia khah ding in TOUPA ma ah ahing in akoih ding hi.
english: But the goat on which the lot fell for the scapegoat shall be presented alive before Yahweh, to make atonement for him, to send him away as the scapegoat into the wilderness.

paite: "Aaron in ama a tuam khelhna bawngtal pen ala dia, amah leh a-inkote a ding in kilemna abawl dia, amah a tuam khelh thoihna bawngtal pen agou ding hi.
english: “Aaron shall present the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make atonement for himself and for his house, and shall kill the bull of the sin offering which is for himself.

paite: TOUPA ma a maitam a pan mei lakna dim in mei-am ala dia, gimlim gawizan ngiingei pham khat toh puanzak sung ah alutpih ding hi.
english: He shall take a censer full of coals of fire from off the altar before Yahweh, and two handfuls of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the veil.

paite: Gimlim khu in thu theihpihna tung a zahngaihna tutphah abopna ding in TOUPA ma a mei ah gimlim abuak dia, sihna atuahlouhna ding in.
english: He shall put the incense on the fire before Yahweh, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is on the covenant, so that he will not die.

paite: Bawngtal sisan bangzah hiam ala dia, akhutzung in zahngaihna tutphah suahlam pang a theh dia, akhut in zahngaihna tutphah bul sisan in sagihvei atheh ding ahi.
english: He shall take some of the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it with his finger on the mercy seat on the east; and before the mercy seat he shall sprinkle some of the blood with his finger seven times.

paite: "Mipi a tuam khelh thoihna kel pen agou dia, asisan, bawngtal sisan abawl bang in abawl dia, zahngaihna tutphah tung leh zahngaihna tutphah ma ah atheh ding hi.
english: “Then he shall kill the goat of the sin offering that is for the people, and bring his blood within the veil, and do with his blood as he did with the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it on the mercy seat and before the mercy seat.

paite: Israel suante sianlouhnate leh akhelhnate ua atatleknate uh ziak in Mun Siangthou a ding in kilemna abawl ding hi. Huai mah bang in, asianlouhnate uh lak a om, kihoupihna biakbuk a ding in leng abawl sam ding hi.
english: He shall make atonement for the Holy Place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions, even all their sins; and so he shall do for the Tent of Meeting that dwells with them in the middle of their uncleanness.

paite: Mun Siangthou a kilemna bawl dia alut lai in, amah leh a-inkote leh Israel mipite a dia kilemna bawl khin a ahong pawtkhiak masiah kuamah puanin sung ah a-om ding ahi kei.
english: No one shall be in the Tent of Meeting when he enters to make atonement in the Holy Place, until he comes out, and has made atonement for himself and for his household, and for all the assembly of Israel.

paite: TOUPA ma a maitam lam ah apawt dia, huai a ding in kilemna abawl dia, bawngtal sisan leh kel sisan bangzah hiam ala dia, maitam kiite ah akimvel in atat ding ahi.
english: “He shall go out to the altar that is before Yahweh and make atonement for it, and shall take some of the bull’s blood, and some of the goat’s blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar.

paite: Akhut in huai sisan sagihvei atheh dia, asiangsak dia, Israel suante sianlouhna a pan ahihsiangthou ding hi.
english: He shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and make it holy from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.

paite: "Mun Siangthou leh kihoupihna biakbuk leh maitam a dia kilemna abawl khit chiang in, kel hing pen ahon kai ding hi.
heading: Khelhna Potu Kel
english: “When he has finished atoning for the Holy Place, the Tent of Meeting, and the altar, he shall present the live goat.

paite: Aaron in kel hing lutung ah akhut langnih akoih dia, atung ah Israel suante gitlouhna teng leh khial a atatlekna teng uh apulak dia; huaite kel lutung ah anga dia, mi khat asehkholhsa un gamdai ah apimang ding hi.
english: Aaron shall lay both his hands on the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions, even all their sins; and he shall put them on the head of the goat, and shall send him away into the wilderness by the hand of a man who is ready.

paite: Huai kel in agitlouhna tengteng uh luah louh gam ah apomang dia, kel bel gamdai ah akhah ding hi.
english: The goat shall carry all their iniquities on himself to a solitary land, and he shall release the goat in the wilderness.

paite: "Kihoupihna puanin ah Aaron alut dia, Mun Siangthou a, alut lai a puanmalngat puansilh asuah dia, huai ah anuse ding hi.
english: “Aaron shall come into the Tent of Meeting, and shall take off the linen garments which he put on when he went into the Holy Place, and shall leave them there.

paite: Mun siangthou ah akisil dia, apuansilh asilh dia, ahong pawtkhe dia, amah a tuam halmang thillat leh mipi a tuam halmang thillat alan dia, amah leh mipi a ding in kilemna abawl ding hi.
english: Then he shall bathe himself in water in a holy place, put on his garments, and come out and offer his burnt offering and the burnt offering of the people, and make atonement for himself and for the people.

paite: Khelh thoihna thau maitam ah ahal ding hi.
english: The fat of the sin offering he shall burn on the altar.

paite: Thuak sik thuak kel khah mi kuapeuh in apuante asawp dia, akisil dia, huai khit in a-omna mun ah apai nawn ding ahi.
english: “He who lets the goat go as the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

paite: Khelh thoihna bawngtal leh khelh thoihna kel sisan kilemna abawlna dia Mun Siangthou a, alutpih uh giahphual pua ah apaipih ding hi; avun, asa leh a-ek ahal ding ahi.
english: The bull for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be carried outside the camp; and they shall burn their skins, their flesh, and their dung with fire.

paite: Ahalmi'n apuan asawp dia, akisil dia, huai khit in a-omna mun ah apai nawn ding ahi.
english: He who burns them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

paite: "Hiai na tangtawn dan thuseh ding uh ahi: Akha sagihna, huai kha ani sawm ni in na lungsimte uh na gimsak ding ua, na gam ua mi himhim hiam, gamdangmi na lak ua teng hiam in bangmah asep louh ding ahi.
heading: Tatna Ni Zatdan Ding
english: “It shall be a statute to you forever: in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, you shall afflict your souls, and shall do no kind of work, whether native-born or a stranger who lives as a foreigner among you;

paite: Hiai ni in noute hihsiangthou ding in noute a ding in kilemna bawl ahi dia; huchi in TOUPA ma ah na khelhna tengteng lak ua pan na siang ding uhi.
english: for on this day shall atonement be made for you, to cleanse you. You shall be clean from all your sins before Yahweh.

paite: Nou a dia Sabbath ni ahi a, na lungsimte uh na gimsak ding uh ahi. Hiai tangtawn dan thuseh ding ahi.
english: It is a Sabbath of solemn rest to you, and you shall afflict your souls. It is a statute forever.

paite: Siampu, apa sik a siampu hi dia sathau nilh ding leh hihtuam mi hi ding in kilemna abawl dia, puanmalngat puansilh siangthou asilh dia; mun siangthou a ding in kilemna abawl dia; kihoupihna biakbuk leh maitam a ding in leng kilemna abawl sam ding hi.
english: The priest, who is anointed and who is consecrated to be priest in his father’s place, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen garments, even the holy garments.

paite: Siampute leh mipihon a ding in kilemna abawl nawn lai ding hi.
english: Then he shall make atonement for the Holy Sanctuary; and he shall make atonement for the Tent of Meeting and for the altar; and he shall make atonement for the priests and for all the people of the assembly.

paite: Akhelhna tengteng uh ziak a kum chih a khatvei Israel suante a dia kilemna bawl na tangtawn dan thuseh ding uh ahi," achi hi. Huchi in TOUPA'N thu apiak bang in Mosi in ahihta hi.
english: “This shall be an everlasting statute for you, to make atonement for the children of Israel once in the year because of all their sins.” It was done as Yahweh commanded Moses.
